decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 16th October 2006, the erection of a rear roof extension with roof windows to front of house, with dimensions of the rear dormer being 4.85m wide, 3.575m deep and 2.2m high, and the roof extension being 2.375m wide, 2.925 deep and 2.45m high, as shown on drawing number 01A, received 16th October 2006, was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extensions consisting of a single storey side extension, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1,Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.

Condition : 2 - Informative: The proposed roof extension must not be higher than any part of the existing ridge of the roof. The original ridgeline and ridge capping of the house should be maintained.

Condition : 3 - Informative: The proposed roof lights to the front elevation of the house hereby found to be lawful shall remain flush fitted within the existing roof slope. Any projection above the existing roof slope would result in the need to apply for a full planning application.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a rear roof extension with roof windows to front of house
